candidates.description: This vector represents the German language and its linguistic, cultural, and national associations.
This vector represents common prefixes, stems, and linguistic roots found in European languages, particularly German and English.
This vector is related to words, names, or morphemes featuring the German umlaut 'ä'.
This vector represents German grammatical articles and pronouns indicating gender, case, and number.
This vector represents common German auxiliary verbs, pronouns, and conjunctions frequently used in grammatical structures.
These tokens represent personal pronouns in German.
German adjectival and nominal suffixes and inflectional endings.
This vector is related to words containing the root or prefix for "imperial," royalty, or empire-related terms across different spellings and languages.
These tokens represent German auxiliary, modal, and subjunctive verbs used to express tense, mood, and modality.
This vector represents historical figures, totalitarian regimes, and major socio-political movements.
